text:
Maya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Maya: Did the route-policy PR (svc-routing#412) that shards by customer-id; canary to staging went fine for 90% of traffic.
Maya: Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s on long-tail requests when seq_len>8 during canary (~1.3% of traffic). suspect rate limiter token-bucket config + burst window. logs show `rate_limit_exceeded` with router trace id `rt-9a3f`.
Alex: Thanks — can you paste a sample log line? I can try to repro locally w/ the same headers.
Maya: here's a minimal curl we used against staging:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Customer-ID: cust-987" \
  -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://staging-api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Maya: When I add `X-Seq-Len: 12` the 429 rate goes up.
Priya: I hit a failing e2e too; looks like auth cache TTL on the edge is 8s and our canary traffic has bursts every 5s, which might cause double fetches and momentary throttles.
Sam: I can do a quick config bump — propose increasing token-bucket burst from 20->50 and TTL to 15s on staging. Will open PR in infra-config.
Alex: Also note a bug in header forwarding: JWT rotation test fails if `X-Forwarded-For` is missing. I'm adding a guard in the gateway middleware.
Maya: @Sam please ping me when you open the PR, want to pair on the rollout policy (canary->ramp->full).
Sam: Will do in ~20m. cc @Priya for e2e retest after config change.
DevBot: [deploy-bot] Canary deploy svc-routing v0.7 -> staging: finished. 5m avg latency 120ms, error spike 1.3% (mostly 429). See /deploys/rt-9a3f
Priya: Quick question — Alex, if we increase TTL to 15s, do we need to adjust cache-invalidation on JWT rotation? might cause a small window where old tokens are accepted.
Alex: Good call. I'll add an invalidation hook on rotation and a short grace period check in middleware.
Maya: Today: monitor canary after Sam's PR, help Alex with middleware tests, and prepare rollback plan if 429>2%.
Sam: I'll post PR URL when ready. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll queue the e2e after Sam's change and report results here.
Alex: I'll add a small unit test and a quick integration with rotated JWT keys.
Maya: Thanks team — async checkin complete. Ping here for pairing.
